apply_transformation.notes: Return unpacks as two values for C04/C05. On failure the result also has failure_code in {unknown_name, domain_zero, domain_negative, nonfinite_input, nonfinite_output, overflow}. sqrt accepts 0; ln and inv_sqrt require >0; inverse and inv_sqr require !=0.

state_fields.name: identity|log
state_fields.parameters: JSON-friendly scalars learned from y_train only (y_min, y_max; log also stores marginal log moments, explicitly not residual variance)

inverse_result_fields.estimand: E[Y|X] or exp(E[log Y|X]) or median(Y|X)

value.mean_ci80: null unless identity and a finite original-scale mean interval was supplied

inverse_result_fields.retransformed_interval: optional; interprets exp(E[log Y|X]); explicitly not mean_ci80

consumers.acceptance_case: C06-A01 sqrt([0,1,4]) succeeds; avaliando idade=0 must no longer force exclusion of sqrt(idade). ln(0), inv_sqrt(0) and inverse(0) remain invalid.
consumers.change_requested: Stop asserting that Transformer rejects sqrt at value <= 0. Keep asserting that ln, inv_sqrt, inverse and inv_sqr are excluded when avaliando idade is 0. Do not require rejection of sqrt(0).

consumers.required_callsite: modules.model_builder: apply_transformation unpack; CandidateFit.target_transform_state; evaluate_fitted must inverse to original unit
consumers.acceptance_case: C06-A05 original-unit inverse; identity numerically equivalent to untransformed Y; sqrt-on-X works even when log-Y intervals are experimental.
consumers.change_requested: Continue unpacking apply_transformation as (series, bool). Persist target_transform_state from fit_target_transform (train only). Call inverse_target_prediction for subject point/interval. Do not put exponentiated log intervals into value.mean_ci80. Comments that lump sqrt with ln/inv_sqrt as strictly-positive are stale.

consumers.acceptance_case: sqrt(0) is domain-valid for X; ranking must use original-unit metrics from inverse_target_prediction, not Shapiro of marginal X.
consumers.change_requested: No C06 edit of this file. After C06, sqrt(avaliando=0) is offered. Compare candidates on original Y unit. Do not rank by Transformer.test_transformations normality scores. Comments that require strictly positive values for sqrt are stale.

consumers.required_callsite: assess_normative predict_original callback and precision interval
consumers.acceptance_case: C06-A05: boundaries on original scale via inverse.invocation; log-Y has normative_classification.status=unavailable and precisao.status=not_computed.
consumers.change_requested: Call modules.target_transform.inverse_target_prediction (state.inverse.invocation) so subject/frontiers are in the original unit. Do not assign a precision grade from an unvalidated log retransformation. Identity remains the legacy-correct path.

consumers.acceptance_case: C06-A04 train-only state; holdout residuals must not estimate smearing or lognormal sigma2.
consumers.change_requested: Fit target transform on the training partition only. When calling inverse_target_prediction, residual_context.origin must be 'train' if a mean correction is requested. Never estimate the correction from the reserved set.
